REGISTRY_STORAGE_DELETE_ENABLED.description: Allow deletion of image blobs and manifests.

REGISTRY_PROXY_REMOTEURL.description: URL of the upstream registry to mirror (e.g., https://registry-1.docker.io). Leave empty for a standalone registry.

REGISTRY_PROXY_USERNAME.description: Username for authenticating with the upstream registry (e.g., Docker Hub username).

REGISTRY_PROXY_PASSWORD.description: Password or access token for the upstream registry.

registry-api.description: Registry API is accessible from this Mac
